 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6e8d1ddd.py",
 "content": "from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = set()
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w
                            and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            objects.append([color, cells])

    # Objects slide right, with objects farther right acting as barriers.
    ordered = sorted(objects, key=lambda obj: max(c for _, c in obj[1]), reverse=True)
    occupied = set().union(*(cells for _, cells in objects)) if objects else set()
    for color, cells in ordered:
        occupied.difference_update(cells)
        shift = 0
        while True:
            if any(c + shift + 1 >= w or (r, c + shift + 1) in occupied
                   for r, c in cells):
                break
            shift += 1
        moved = {(r, c + shift) for r, c in cells}
        cells.clear()
        cells.update(moved)
        occupied.update(cells)

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, cells in objects:
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
